title: Set up the Thermite toolchain workspace and CI

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: v0.1 = transpile-to-Verus toolchain (see knowledge page thermite-architecture-v0.1). Scope: Cargo workspace with crates thermite-syntax (lexer/parser/AST), thermite-lower (AST->Verus source), forge (CLI), thermite-skill (skill generator). Plus CI skeleton (fmt/clippy/test) and a stub for the 6k-token skill-budget gate (#7). MSRV pin + rust-toolchain. No code logic yet, just the buildable skeleton other v0.1 issues land in.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Scaffold via ACToR loop: doc-author (.design/scaffold/workspace.md = crate topology + dep direction + MSRV/edition + CI gauntlet) -> builder (workspace Cargo.toml, per-crate Cargo.toml + minimal lib.rs/main.rs, rust-toolchain, CI; add lib.rs/main.rs routes to spec-routes.toml; empty workspace must pass cargo build/test/clippy -D warnings/fmt) -> critic (audit vs doc + goal.md) -> fixer/builder. doc-author step is forced by the spec-discipline gate (lib.rs is a gated path needing a design doc).

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Scaffold SHIPPED via ACToR loop (doc-author -> builder -> critic -> refinement). Commits: 05c65b7 (scaffold), 0c7fbda (post-audit refinements). Five-crate virtual workspace (thermite-syntax/spec/lower + forge[bin] + thermite-skill), leaf-first DAG, edition 2021, channel 1.95.0 pinned, CI gauntlet (build/test/clippy -D warnings/fmt) wired. No error type (REQ-3 amended: per-crate errors deferred to owning issues). acto-critic verdict: NO DIVERGENCE on all 7 ACs, gauntlet independently re-run 4/4 green. Orchestrator cross-validation caught 2 post-audit hygiene gaps the critic missed (CI installer was @stable not pinned; target/ + stray crosslink caches not gitignored) — both fixed in 0c7fbda. Design contract: .design/scaffold/workspace.md (REQ-1..6 SHIPPED, REQ-7 deferred to #7). Not pushed (human pushes).
